description: This file contains helper functions and constants for managing agent communication sessions, including context building, target resolution, and ping-pong turn configuration.

methods.name: resolveAnnounceTargetFromKey
methods.description: Resolves an announce target from a session key, normalizing channel IDs and determining the session target.

methods.name: buildAgentToAgentMessageContext
methods.description: Builds a string representing the context of an agent-to-agent message, including session details.

methods.name: buildAgentToAgentReplyContext
methods.description: Builds a reply context string for agent-to-agent communication, indicating current turn and role.

methods.name: buildAgentToAgentAnnounceContext
methods.description: Builds an announcement context string for agent-to-agent communication, including original message and replies.

methods.name: resolvePingPongTurns
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of ping-pong turns based on configuration, with fallback to default values.
